description: LW12: on a system without PTYs, terminal.open refuses with a named `unsupported` — it does not fall back to a pipe. A pipe is not a terminal: no job control, no tty lines, no stty; a shell in one would half-work and mislead.

error.message: terminals are unsupported on this OS

data.means: no shell was started — a PTY is the one thing a terminal session cannot be faked without, and a pipe is not a terminal (no job control, no tty lines, no stty)
data.todo: run the daemon on a system with PTYs; the package builds everywhere, only `open` refuses
